caption: turn Orderless on, then read it back with Attributes (the Nothing result of SetAttributes itself vanishes from the enclosing List)
wolfram.note: Wolfram's real HarmonicMean symbol already carries Protected/ReadProtected attributes we don't model, so Attributes[HarmonicMean] returns all three, not just the Orderless this example adds; also Wolfram's SetAttributes returns Null (kept in the list), where our own semantics vanish a Nothing result.

Attributes reads compute-engine's operator flags, which cannot say HoldFirst: a lazy head is reported as HoldAll, and Protected is not modeled. Wolfram answers {HoldFirst, Protected}; the attribute metadata here is incomplete.
